caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top and eight legs, rendered in shades of brown. The table appears to have a drop-leaf design, with one leaf extended and the other side not visible. The legs are carved in a classic style, each ending in a rounded foot, and they are arranged with four on each side, suggesting support for the extended leaf. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present in the composition. The entire scene is presented on a flat, perspective plane with careful attention to shading and wood grain texture on the table's surfaces.
title: Gate-legged Table, Ball & Claw Feet
